verdict.rationale: Rev AI's own feature docs describe a custom vocabulary feature for submitting words and terms that are not in the average English dictionary to improve ASR accuracy, which is the core of this story. The evidence is a single line with no further detail. Missing for 10: documentation of vocabulary limits and how to submit lists, whether it works on both async and streaming APIs, any boost or weighting control, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the accuracy gains.

support.subject: As a developer, I can boost domain terms, names, and jargon through custom vocabulary or keyword boosting so they transcribe correctly

citations.quote: To improve accuracy of the ASR when using words or terms that are not in the average English dictionary, submit these words as custom vocabulary.
